method.comparison: Tuesday vs all other Monday–Friday sessions (not next-day-gap=1 ordinary days)
method.bonferroni: min(1, p*5) within each metric/sample for selected weekday; not global study-wide correction
method.tests: 5x2 Pearson chi-square; tie-corrected Kruskal-Wallis; pooled two-proportion z; OLS HC1 or Newey-West(5) asymptotic normal
method.us_alignment: strictly last available US date < TW date; adjusted close/previous adjusted close - 1
method.settlement: nominal third-Wednesday eve; no actual expiry/holiday adjustment data

settlement.friday_expiry_status: 不可判斷：本機無契約到期日、上市日或實際結算資料；2025年後週四僅為星期代理，不標成週五到期前日。
